name: hint
title: Hint
description: A hint text component for form fields with icon, error, and disabled states. Uses namespace exports: Hint.Root, Hint.Icon.

docs.lead: A hint text component for form fields with icon support and error/disabled states.
docs.usage:
import * as Hint from "@/components/ui/hint"

<Hint.Root>
  <Hint.Icon as={RiInformationFill} />
  This is a hint text.
</Hint.Root>

examples.title: Demo

api.name: Hint.Icon
api.description: Icon displayed before the hint text.
